title: Startup MVP Team
summary: Idea to launch-ready MVP: parallel market and user discovery, a product brief, the full Feature Delivery team as a sub-team, and — only if the reality gate says READY — a launch squad; otherwise a recovery plan.

idea.description: The product idea, target users, and any constraints

nodes.task:
Quick competitive and market scan for: {{input.idea}}

Top competitors and their gaps, market timing, and the single sharpest positioning opportunity. One page, not a full report.

Define the target users for: {{input.idea}}

Two or three personas, their top jobs-to-be-done, and the critical user flow the MVP must nail.
Write the MVP product spec: problem, target user, the smallest feature set that tests the core value hypothesis (with explicit non-goals), success metrics, and acceptance criteria per feature.

inputs.brief:
A launch announcement (blog post plus three social posts) for this MVP:
{{nodes.brief.output}}
inputs.author: marketing-content-creator

nodes.task: The MVP did not pass the reality gate (verdict: {{nodes.deliver.verdict}}). Using the delivery summary, decide: cut scope, extend by one sprint, or pivot the approach. Give a concrete recovery plan with owners (agent roles) and a date-free sequence of steps.
